phone.notes: The names of small Digimon (Baby I and II) no longer show as an empty box in battle, and the Digimon of a team has the same look as in the Farm, with its blue and white points shown. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Wild fights no longer pause when the watch goes to sleep, and the card adventure belongs to each Digimon: the watch reports the missions of the Digimon it carries.
